_published_faq.name: How do I add Laki.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Laki.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.laki.ai/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Laki.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laki.ai provides these MCP tools: begin_research, finalize_research_graph, get_statute_section_history, get_table_of_contents, read_document, search_legal_sources, and search_within_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Laki.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Laki.ai in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
Laki.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Laki.ai is developed by Laki.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
